newsitem.title: USA: Ameriwood says did not get key Q1 order.
newsitem.headline: Ameriwood says did not get key Q1 order.

text.p: Ameriwood Industries International Corp said certain anticipated orders from a new customer with significant national distribution did not materialize in the first quarter.

"The company had dedicated capacity to the new account and, like certain of its competitors, was negatively affected by a postponed national rollout of the anticipated program," said the unassembled furniture and stereo speakers maker.
Excluding a one-time litigation gain, the company reported a first-quarter net loss of $378,000 on sales of $24.9 million, compared to year-ago period net income of $66,400 on sales of $27.9 million.
